title: Senate Approves Landmark Defense Bill Amid Controversy
description: The U.S. Senate passed the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for the 64th consecutive year, moving it to President Biden's desk. The legislation includes provisions on transgender care restrictions, Taiwan support, and pay raises for troops, while also addressing concerns related to China and military quality of life.

title: Corruption Scandal Upends China's Military Modernization Goals
description: The Pentagon's annual report reveals that corruption within China's military has possibly disrupted the country's 2027 military modernization goals. At least 15 high-ranking military officials were removed due to corruption investigations, affecting progress towards strategic objectives, including a potential invasion of Taiwan.

title: China-Taiwan Tensions Escalate Over US Tank Delivery
description: China's Foreign Ministry dismissed Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense after US-delivered tanks arrived in Taiwan. Beijing criticized the US for military ties with Taipei, reiterating the one-China principle. Taiwanese officials rejected China's claims, affirming the existence of their Ministry of National Defense and commitment to democracy.

title: Strait Diplomacy: Dialogue over Discord
description: Taipei's mayor urged Chinese officials for peace and dialogue amid increasing military tensions around Taiwan. Addressing the Taipei-Shanghai Forum, Mayor Chiang advocated for reduced confrontations. Despite ongoing military activities by China, Chiang emphasized the need for continuous communication, while Shanghai seeks practical cooperation and tourism revival.
